text:
maria: Hey team — HelixMed just sent a final PO but Legal pushed DPA redlines that touch data residency + HSM. Need routing for countersign and orderform + PO path. Quick help?

tj_se: Can you paste the key clauses? any tech blocker? :thinking:

maria: Copy from their redline:
```
Section 3.2 Data Location: Customer requires all PHI to be stored in eu-west-1 only.
Section 7.1 KMS/HSM: Customer requires dedicated HSM-backed key management with BYOK.
Section 9.5 SLA: 99.9% uptime with credits sliding scale, plus 2hr response for severity 1.
```

olivia: Procurement note — they'll issue a PO net45 to entity "HelixMed EU Ltd". We need to confirm billing entity + tax docs. Also ask: do we accept PO + e-sign or do they require wet-ink?

nate: Legal: Helix redlines are not unreasonable but BYOK + strict residency push this towards Dedicated/Private. We can offer a carveout: host in eu region + customer-managed KMS for Dedicated or Private. Hosted (multi-tenant) doesn't support full BYOK currently. If customer insists on hosted+BYOK, that's an enterprise add-on and needs SOW + security review.

anya_sec: From security: we can provide SCCs + SOC2 report. BYOK with dedicated HSM requires either Dedicated with KMS integration or Private VPC. We'll need to capture key rotation policy, access controls, and attestations.

maria: Helix asked explicitly: "can you do hosted with BYOK?" — they'll prefer not to sign up for a multi-month Private deployment. Any short path?

tj_se: Options to propose:
- Option A: Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with KMS integration (fastest path, requires commit and billing entity mapping).
- Option B: Hosted with a key-proxy (limited BYOK simulation) — kinda ad-hoc and legal may reject.
- Option C: Private VPC deployment (full BYOK, longer lead time + SOW).

olivia: For signature routing: CFO wants PO routed to vendor billing + legal for countersign. DocuSign acceptable? Also need to know who signs on Redwood side (legal or sales exec).

nate: DocuSign is fine. We'll countersign via DocuSign. Please attach redlines and mark which clauses should be escalated to SOW. Maria, send PO number + billing entity so I can prep the counter-sign package.

maria: PO# HM-2026-1129, billing entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (EU billing). PO link: https://files.internal/helixmed/PO_HM-2026-1129.pdf

tj_se: Quick sec question: any blocking SOC2 scope gaps for EU-only processing that would block Dedicated?

anya_sec: We can scope SOC2 coverage for EU processing. HSM BYOK requires additional controls and likely extra attestation. I can draft a response to the security questionnaire and propose mitigations (key escrow ops, audit logs, RBAC). ETA EOD.

olivia: I'll prepare procurement checklist and DocuSign envelope routing. Proposed envelope recipients order: 1) helix CFO (signature) 2) helix legal (ack) 3) maria (sales) 4) nate (redwood legal) — any objections? Also need VAT/tax form before first invoice.

nate: No objections. Add a note in the DocuSign: "execution for signature only; refer to SOW HM-2026-SOW-01 for BYOK and residency details". I'll attach short redline summary.

maria: Thanks. @nate @anya_sec please drop the redline summary + security Q answers here when ready. I'll update Helix and move to DocuSign today. :rocket:

deploy-bot: docuSign envelope created by maria at 2026-03-23T15:12Z — envelope id: env_0a1b2c3d

olivia: Heads-up: Helix asked about billing contact mapping so invoices go to AP-EU@helixmed.eu. I'll add that to the envelope.

maria: Perfect — I'll ping Helix with the proposed path: Dedicated (eu-west-1) + KMS integration term sheet + DocuSign for PO. Will update thread after they respond.
